description:
Quebec Clothes Moth Killer is a potent solution designed to combat the menace of clothes moths effectively. In a convenient 300ml container, it offers a reliable defense against these destructive pests, ensuring the protection of your valuable textiles and fabrics. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, this product combines efficacy with user convenience, making it an essential tool in moth control. Its formula is tailored to target clothes moths specifically, providing a targeted approach to eliminating them from your home. The 300ml size ensures you have an ample supply to tackle infestations and safeguard your wardrobe, carpets, and upholstery from moth damage. Easy to use, simply apply the Quebec Clothes Moth Killer to affected areas or use it preventatively in closets, drawers, and storage spaces. Its fast-acting formula starts to work upon contact, swiftly eradicating adult moths and their larvae, thereby interrupting the breeding cycle and preventing further infestations. With Quebec Clothes Moth Killer, you can trust in its efficacy and reliability to keep your belongings safe from the destructive habits of clothes moths, giving you peace of mind and preserving the integrity of your fabrics for years to come.

 

Usage Instructions:

  • Shake the can well before use.
  • Hold the can upright and spray evenly from a distance of about 30 cm (12 inches) on areas where moths are present or likely to be found.
  • Focus on closets, drawers, carpets, and other storage areas.
  • Allow treated areas to dry before returning clothing or other items.
  • For best results, reapply every few months or as needed.

 

Safety Information:

  • Keep out of reach of children and pets.
  • Avoid inhalation and direct contact with skin and eyes.
  • Use in well-ventilated areas.
  • Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

 

Features

  • Advanced Formula
  • Long-lasting Treatment
  • Protects Clothes in Storage
  • Professional-quality products you can trust
  • Kills clothes moths, their larvae, and eggs
